coverLetter:
Priya Raman
Toronto, Canada
priya.raman@example.com
+1 555 0176

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Coinbase

Dear Hiring Manager,

Designing a settlement service that processed tens of millions of Kafka events daily while keeping a payment status API well under 200ms is the kind of infrastructure problem I find genuinely interesting, and it maps directly to what Coinbase's Payments team is building: a reliable, high-throughput platform that other teams can build on without touching the core.

At Lumen Payments, I owned that settlement service end-to-end in Kotlin and Spring Boot, from initial design through on-call support and post-incident reviews. When latency became a bottleneck, I diagnosed the hot-read pattern and moved those reads from PostgreSQL to Redis, cutting p99 response time by more than half. I also led a nine-month migration from a monolith into six discrete services, which gave me a clear view of how platform primitives and clean service boundaries determine whether downstream teams can move independently or get stuck waiting. My background is in Java and Kotlin rather than Go, but the distributed systems patterns I've applied across event-driven architectures translate directly, and I pick up new languages quickly when the problem domain is familiar.

I'd welcome a conversation about how this experience fits the Payments platform work at Coinbase, and I'm available to talk at your convenience.

Best regards,
Priya Raman

applicationEmail.subject: Application: Senior Software Engineer, Backend, Priya Raman
applicationEmail.body:
Hi there,

After four years building Lumen Payments' core settlement service in Kotlin and Spring Boot, processing around 40 million events a day on Kafka, I know what it takes to keep payment infrastructure correct and reliable at scale. I also led the migration of a monolith into six independent services and cut p99 latency on a payment status API from 480 ms to 120 ms, the kind of end-to-end ownership your team is looking for. My CV and cover letter are attached for your review. I am available for a call any weekday and can start within a few weeks of an offer.

Best regards,
Priya Raman
